content:
Tess SRE: alert: ap-southeast2 control plane 5xx spike + attach failures for rtx nodepool starting 07:43 UTC. apiserver_5xx alert firing. :rotating_light:
Marco Infra: checking infra events, see a routing flap and partial MTU rollout around 07:40. Some nodes still report 1500 while others 9000.
Jun Eng: apiserver logs show repeated `read tcp ...:6443 ...: i/o timeout` and etcd grpc: `transport is closing`. controller-manager `AttachVolume` DeadlineExceeded loops.
Felix Ops: costs increasing due to retry attach ops. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ops/attach-costs panel shows spike. Finance should be looped in PM.
Marco Infra: running health checks now. suspect PMTU blackhole + transient NAT port pressure from many concurrent CSI calls.
Tess SRE: quick mitigations: 1) patch controller-manager to reduce `--concurrent-attaches` from 20->5 and increase reconcile period; 2) roll MTU fix to mismatched hosts; 3) expand NAT ephemeral pool as short-term. Can we do 1 and 2 immediately?
Jun Eng: will canary controller-manager flag changes to 1 replica. Patching now.
InfraBot: [action] INC-2026-4012 created, severity=high, owner=Marco Infra, notify=#oncall.
Marco Infra: MTU job applied to 7/9 hosts, fixing tags for remaining 2. Also expanding NAT pool for rtx nodes.
Jun Eng: canary looks good, leader election stabilized and attach failures reduced within 90s.
Tess SRE: please verify etcd peer latency and raft elections remain nominal for 30m. Leave canary for 10m before rolling.
Felix Ops: noted estimated attach retry billing ~320 USD for the window, added to incident notes.
Marco Infra: MTU verified on remaining hosts at 07:50 UTC, running `ping -M dont -s 8972` and `ip link show`.
InfraBot: [update] INC-2026-4012 severity=degraded. Condition: awaiting 30m steady state.
Tess SRE: status at 07:50 UTC = apiserver 5xx back to baseline, controller-manager restarts stopped. Postmortem plan: root cause = partial MTU roll + transient NAT port pressure -> PMTU blackholing and packet drops -> etcd heartbeat delays -> control plane leader jitter -> attach thrash. Remediations: preflight MTU verification, ICMP allow check, NAT sizing guidance, safer controller-manager defaults.
Jun Eng: will prepare PR for controller-manager default changes and add attach-rate alert.
Tess SRE: thanks everyone. Ping if it recurs. :thumbsup:
